newsitem.title: USA: API says U.S. crude stocks rose in week.
newsitem.headline: API says U.S. crude stocks rose in week.

text.p: U.S. crude oil stocks held in primary storage rose 516,000 barrels in the week ended Feb 21 to 305.40 million barrels from 304.88 million barrels the prior week, the American Petroleum Institute (API) said Tuesday.
API said that crude stocks excluding PADD 5 (Petroleum Administration for Defense District) fell 1.79 million barrels in the week to 240.28 million barrels.
Distillate stocks fell 1.62 million barrels to 106.09 million from 107.71 million the previous week.
API said PADD 1 distillate stocks fell 507,000 barrels to 38.81 million barrels.
API said gasoline production rose 31,000 barrels in the week to 7.32 million bpd from 7.29 million.
Gasoline stocks fell 3.17 million barrels in the week to 203.12 million barrels from 206.29 million barrels.
Percent of stocks capacity rose to 88.8 percent from 88.3 percent.
API said reformulated gasoline stocks (RFG) fell 1.80 million barrels to 37.65 million barrels from 39.44 million barrels in the previous week.
API said crude runs to processing units rose to 13.42 million barrels from 13.39 million barrels.
Residual fuel stocks in the latest week fell to 40.71 million barrels from 42.62 million in the previous week.
Crude oil imports fell to 7.25 million barrels per day from 7.43 million, API said.
